name: neither-mcp
description: Decision memory with Decision/Rejected/Constraint/Citation via memory_for_file
long_description: Neither is decision memory for Cursor and Claude Desktop. This bundle starts the published stdio MCP server with `npx -y @neitherai/mcp-server@latest` (no vendored node_modules). Tools return cited Decision / Rejected / Constraint / Citation prose, including supersession — not flat chat memory. Free history is roughly a 3-day snapshot. Get a workspace key at the homepage URL.

tools.name: memory_for_file
tools.description: Cited Decision/Rejected/Constraint/Citation prose for a repo file path

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: Natural-language search over workspace decision memory

tools.name: memory_snippet_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a verbatim snippet by provenance source_id

tools.name: memory_timeline
tools.description: Time-ordered memory view for a topic or anchor

tools.name: memory_push
tools.description: Close a decision or seed an ADR snippet with provenance
